business_summary: Greenland Holdings Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through the Real Estate and Related Industries; Consumer and Producer Services Industries; Financial Investment Industry; Large Infrastructure Industry; and Other Business segments. The company develops residential, high-rise buildings, large-scale urban complexes, high-speed rail new towns, characteristic towns, international convention and exhibition centers, and modern industrial parks; and undertakes infrastructure projects, including rail transit, highways, and municipal bridges. It is also involved in real estate operations; imported goods, cross-border trade, hotels and tourism, energy supply, and automobile sales and services; and housing and infrastructure construction, financial information services, landscaping, engineering, and property management. In addition, the company engages in investment and asset management; leasing; accommodation; science and technology entrepreneurship park operation and management; wine, beverage, and fine tea manufacturing; building decoration and renovation; professional technical services; software and information technology; energy development; taxi services; real estate and industrial investment; urban construction; wholesale; commerce; warehousing; business consulting; business; and culture and art activities. Greenland Holdings Corporation Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
